text: Frequently Asked Questions - Mail.tm Inbox Refresh Email Testing You can support us by disabling your ad blocker on our site 🙏 Privacy Manager API FAQ Privacy Feedback Contacts Mail.gw © Mail.tm Back Frequently Asked Questions What is temporary / disposable / anonymous mail? A disposable mailbox is a temporary, completely anonymous email address that requires no registration. Why would I need a temporary email address? For signing up on sites you don't fully trust, for anonymous conversations, forums and giveaways: any situation where you want messages delivered instantly without exposing your identity. How is it different from regular mail? It requires no registration It is completely anonymous: your personal data, the address itself and all emails are erased once you delete the mailbox Messages are delivered instantly The address is generated automatically, so there is no hunting for a free username; The mailbox is protected from spam, hacking and exploits. How do I send an email? Unfortunately, we do not provide this feature. How do I extend the lifetime of my temporary mailbox? There is nothing to extend: your mailbox stays valid until you delete it yourself. How long do you store incoming messages? We store messages for 7 days only. Sorry, we can't keep them indefinitely. Can I read the emails I receive? Yes, they appear right under your mailbox address, showing the sender, the subject and the text of each message. If the email you're waiting for isn't there yet, click "Refresh". Do you keep renewing the domains used by this service? Yes, we always renew our domains, so they won't disappear. I forgot my password. Can you reset it? No. Your password is generated in your browser and stored encrypted, so there is no way for us to reset it.
